"estate hospital assistant? means a person who has passed
any of the examinations pr¢scribed by any regulations made

"probationer estate hospital assistant" means a person
who has not passed any |of the examinations prescribed

referred to in section 9, but is undergoing training in an
approved institution for the purpose of becoming an estate
hospital assistant;

"Minister" means the Minister charged with the responsi-
bility for health.
